summary: troubleshooting@99.0.1 beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP collector on install and require
details: The package ships a postinstall script that runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs JSON containing os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the Node version to a hardcoded plain-HTTP endpoint at bare IP 185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The same beacon is invoked from index.js on require, so both installing and importing the package exfiltrate installer host and path identifiers. The destination is a non-configurable bare IP unrelated to any publisher or vendor domain. The package's main export is a no-op Proxy that returns a stub for any accessed property, so arbitrary consumer imports succeed without doing anything useful. Combined with the generic name 'troubleshooting', the inflated version 99.0.1, and the 'Compatibility shim' description, the artifact has the shape of a dependency-confusion / internal-asset confirmation beacon designed to report back when it lands inside a private build environment.
